key: But will God in very truth dwell on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain Thee; how much less this house that I have builded!
s: Dedicating the Temple, Solomon turns in his prayer to what the house can be; Radak, on 8:27, reads the house as a figure, since no place contains God, and its purpose as prayer heard there more readily, the chosen place aiding like an interceding angel.

evidence.gloss: That is: is it true that God dwells with man on earth? That cannot be believed, for You are exalted above all, no place contains You, You are the place of the world and the world is not Your place; so my building the house for You is only by way of figure, that Your will and glory be found in this house to hear the prayer prayed in this place; and though His will in every place is toward whoever cries to Him with a whole heart, Solomon asked God that this chosen place help the one who prays, as though the house were an interceding angel, and that prayer here be heard more nearly than in another place.
